messages:
DeployBot: Heads-up: scheduled rollout for release/3.5.1 at 2026-02-14T01:00:00Z. Soft-freeze starts 2026-02-14T00:00:00Z, hard-freeze at 2026-02-14T00:45:00Z. Pin gateway -> v3.5.1-rc1. This thread = live handoff + rollback comms.
Nina P: Noted. Quick question: are we enabling the new batching policy in this wave or holding until after full ramp?
Omar K: Hold batching for canary; enable at 50% if no regressions. I verified model checksum for gen-large-q4.
Riley: Checklist for release readiness: docs updated, release notes merged, migration plan reviewed, SLO owners looped, canary buckets configured. I updated the checklist in the PR.
Jorge M: I'll take on-call for T+0 to T+90m. Primary watch: 4xx/5xx delta, memory growth on gpu-nodes, queue lengths.
Tess L: Observability links: https://console.redwood.ai/d/3.5.1/overview and temporary alert created: canary-5xx > 1% -> notify #eng-oncall.
Nina P: Canary plan: bucket A = 5% for 10m, bucket B = 25% for 15m, then 70% for 15m -> final 100%. Rollback rules: sustained 5xx > 1.5% for 5m, p50 increase > 150ms sustained 10m, or model output regression on eval set (auto-eval drop > 2%).
Omar K: Migration details: schema change adds nullable column, safe backfill job queued but disabled until 50% traffic. Backfill rate = 2000 rows/min.
Riley: Release notes snippet in PR #519: "3.5.1 - minor infra fixes, improved kernel selection, opt-in batching deferred."
Jorge M: My kickoff checklist (T-5): confirm deploy-bot credentials, warm up connection pools, verify canary oauth tokens.
DeployBot: Deploy command: `/deploy release/3.5.1 --canary 5% --buckets 4 --timeout 1800s`
Tess L: Smoke script I'll run from ops:
```
# quick smoke
http GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
http POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings Authorization:"Bearer $TOKEN" text="smoke"
./scripts/check_grafana_canary.sh 3.5.1
```
Nina P: Note: embeddings-experiment team asked for temporary exemption from hard-freeze for a hotfix path. Process: request in-thread + @product signoff + QA run. No silent approvals.
Omar K: Agreed. If exemption requested, require explicit change in this thread and update deploy-bot with `--exempt-id` param.
DeployBot: Canary roll started at 2026-02-14T01:00:30Z (bucket A, 5%). Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/deploys/3155554321
Jorge M: Bucket A smoke OK at +4m. No 5xx, p50 stable. Proceed to bucket B (25%).
DeployBot: Ramping to bucket B at 2026-02-14T01:08:12Z
Tess L: Minor alert noise during ramp (transient) — no sustained threshold breaches.
Riley: Bucket B steady for 15m, metrics green. Preparing final ramp.
Omar K: Enabling migrations and backfill toggle now at 25% -> set backfill rate to 2000 rows/min and enable.
DeployBot: Final ramp completed at 2026-02-14T01:30:58Z. Pods healthy, instances reporting ready.
Nina P: Post-deploy tasks: tag release artifacts, publish changelog, share announcement to #announcements and notify enterprise customers per runbook.
Jorge M: I'll monitor for another 60m then handover to eng-sre. If anything, page me to escalate.
Tess L: Removing temporary canary pager rule; keeping passive dashboards for 2h.
Riley: Closing hard-freeze at 2026-02-14T02:15:00Z. Thanks all. :rocket:
DeployBot: Deploy summary: success, duration 45m, no rollback required. Artifacts: s3://releases/3.5.1/; changelog PR #519 merged.
